comments.author: huutuan1705
comments.body: I fixed it. I think that `retrieval_average_precision` function does not receive tensors, which are negative value. The line `distance = -1*self.distance_fn(sk_feat.unsqueeze(0), gallery)` make distance become a negative tensor, so I just change it into `distance = 1 - self.distance_fn(sk_feat.unsqueeze(0), gallery)`
